{{Quote|The ''Bespin Dancer''. Is&mdash;was&mdash;she still part of the Falleen group?"''<br />"''I believe so. Senator&mdash;."''<br />"''My wife's cousin is a tac officer on the ''Dancer''.''"<br />"''Then, Senator, I am sorry for your loss.|Senator Bail Organa and Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi after the the loss of the ''Bespin Dancer''|<ref name="WS" />}}
The '''''Bespin Dancer''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that shared part of its name<ref name="WS" /> with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="WS" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the ship was destroyed with all hands lost during the [[Fall of Falleen]], which was fought against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa's]] [[Breha Organa's cousin|cousin]] served as a tactical [[Officer/Legends|officer]] aboard the ship and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the battle. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] later reported the fact to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of Queen Breha. However, as the details of the Battle of [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] included sensitive information, Kenobi advised Organa not to tell his [[Gender/Legends|wife]] about the event.<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Bespin Dancer'' was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a tie-in novel for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="WS" />
